messages:
emma_ml: Heads up — onboarding HF model `gpt-lite-3` showed tokenization mismatch vs our conversion. Eval BLEU drop ~3.2 points on chat evals.
ryan_infra: what kind of mismatch? prefix/suffix spaces, unicode, or special tokens?
karen_research: saw this earlier — tokenizer normalizer in HF used 'NFKD' + remove control chars; our converter defaulted to NFC. small diff but affects leading combining marks.
emma_ml: repro attached below. Feed: "café\u0301 test" -> HF token ids vs Redwood converted ids.
miguel_qe: can you paste raw output? will run the quantized path too.
emma_ml: here's minimal repro:
```python
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
hf = Tokenizer.from_file('hf_tokenizer.json')
red = Tokenizer.from_file('redwood_conv.json')
s = 'cafe\u0301 leading\u00A0space'
print(hf.encode(s).tokens)
print(red.encode(s).tokens)
```
emma_ml: HF tokens: ['cafe', '\u0301', ' leading', '\u00A0space']
emma_ml: Redwood tokens: ['cafe\u0301', ' leading', '\u00A0space']
ryan_infra: aha — HF split combining mark separately, our converter merged it. explains token count variance and kv-cache offsets.
karen_research: that will shift logits after quantization too — small alignment changes can amplify in 4-bit.
miguel_qe: ran quant bench on dedicated with int8/4bit; quality delta only on sequences with combining marks and nonbreaking spaces.
emma_ml: also noticed HF enables byte-fallback for unknowns; our config had `fallback: false` by mistake.
ryan_infra: patch idea: port HF normalizer settings explicitly (NFKD vs NFC), enable byte_fallback, and preserve 'add_prefix_space' for chat templates.
emma_ml: putting up PR with conversion fix + unit test for 10 tricky unicode cases.
devbot: conversion-tool v0.9.1 started on branch fix/tokenizer-normalizer
miguel_qe: test plan — run 100k chat evals, compare token-alignment diffs and rerun quantized artifact generation.
karen_research: also add a prompt-wrapper check: our chat wrap was inserting a leading space post-conversion which HF expects on input tokens.
ryan_infra: assign @emma_ml and @miguel_qe to follow up, ping @platform for release cadence.
emma_ml: will do, uploading failing prompts to /internal/evals/tokenizer_norm_hf_vs_red.json
miguel_qe: I'll add regression alert to the dashboard, set threshold BLEU drop >1.0
karen_research: thanks — this explains the weird BLEU blips during last deployment :+1:
